beats.say: When you work from home or a cafe, the office's protection does not come with you. You have to build it yourself.
Connect to work systems only through your organisation's VPN. Free VPN apps can pass your data to others.
Anyone can fake the name of an open cafe network. If you can, use your phone's hotspot instead.
People behind you can see your screen and typed password. Sit with your back to a wall and use a privacy filter.
The work laptop is not for the family. A game someone at home downloads can bring malware with it.

scenes.prompt: Which networks in this cafe are suspicious?

spots.label: Look-alike name
spots.explain: An open network that mimics the cafe's name. It has no password and may be fake. Ask staff for the real one.

spots.label: Unknown owner
spots.explain: An open network with no known owner can send you to a fake login page.

spots.label: Your organisation's name
spots.explain: Your organisation's network cannot be in a cafe. This one was set up to fool you.

scenes.prompt: Which of these is safe for working from home?

cards.explain: Factory passwords are public knowledge. Change the router password now.

body.text: I can't get into the system from home. Tell me your password, just for a minute.

cards.explain: A password is never shared, not even with a colleague. Suggest he contacts tech support.

body.text: The update will install on your work computer automatically. Do not download anything.

cards.explain: The domain is correct and you are not asked to download anything.
An unknown free VPN can read your traffic. Use only the organisation's VPN for work.
A password protected home network. If the router password was changed too, it is a good start.

scenes.title: At home and in a cafe

nodes.text: Can I install a game on your work laptop? Mine is too slow.
nodes.speaker: Family member
nodes.spoken: Can I install a game on your work laptop? <short pause> Mine is too slow.

choices.label: Fine, just for an hour
choices.feedback: Malware came with the game and your work accounts are now at risk.

choices.label: No, the work laptop is for work only

nodes.text: Next day you are working in a cafe. You need to go to the counter to order, and your laptop is open.

choices.label: Leave it open, it's only two minutes
choices.feedback: Two minutes is enough to look, plug in a drive or take the laptop.

choices.label: Lock the screen and take the laptop with me

nodes.text: Back at your table, your manager calls and asks for figures from a confidential project. People are sitting nearby.

choices.label: Say the figures out loud
choices.feedback: People nearby can hear. Confidential talk does not happen in public.

choices.label: Say I will call back from a quiet place
choices.feedback: Well done. Have confidential calls only where no one can overhear.

question.prompt: Which steps matter for your home router?

options.label: Change the factory admin password
options.feedback: Anyone can look up a factory password.

options.label: Choose WPA3 or WPA2 encryption
options.feedback: It protects your network from eavesdropping.

options.label: Leave Wi-Fi without a password for speed
options.feedback: Anyone could join, and it does not make it faster.

scenes.explain: The router is your home's door to the internet. A factory password and old firmware leave it open.

points: Connect to work systems only through the organisation's VPN.
Use your phone's hotspot instead of open Wi-Fi.
Do not share the work laptop with family, and lock the screen.
